video_title: Keyone George on new contract, Jazz's expectations and supporting coach's ALS foundation | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Frank Vogel's coaching value for the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Steve Kerr always changes up the roster. He likes bringing some great minds in.
quotes.quote: Great value, long-time head coach. Steve Kerr always changes up the roster. He likes bringing some great minds in and listens. I thought Willie Green was coming, but it's Frank Vogel. Big pick up for the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Finch's perspective on the Minnesota Timberwolves' roster construction
quotes.excerpt: Time to take the diapers off is his head referring specifically to Anthony Edwards.
quotes.quote: Chris Finch just had a really interesting, expansive interview with the Minnesota Post. In part of that, he talked about the way they built the roster, not having a lot of wise vets like a Mike Conley, like a Joe Ingles, the guys who have run that locker room. Time to take the diapers off is his head referring specifically to Anthony Edwards as the leader of that team.

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Reflecting on Nicolas Batum's 18-year NBA career
quotes.excerpt: Respect to this Frenchman, one of the best French careers in NBA history.
quotes.quote: First of all, Tony Parker always calls him the 'Nico'. So Nico, congratulations. 18 years in the NBA, 1200 games. Respect to this Frenchman, one of the best French careers in NBA history.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Lowry's impact and legacy as a Toronto Raptor
quotes.excerpt: When you talk about impact, longevity, the role he played to bring the championship to Toronto.
quotes.quote: If the franchise gives him that label and wants to give him that distinction, who am I to argue? Certainly, when you talk about impact, longevity, the role he played to bring the championship to Toronto, he has a heck of a case. Now, maybe Kawhi can make his own case with his second stint.

quotes.speaker: Keyonte George
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George supporting Coach Will Hardy's ALS foundation
quotes.excerpt: We are just here to support our coach, Coach Will, for his foundation for ALS.
quotes.quote: We are just here to support our coach, Coach Will, for his foundation for ALS. I am still trying to raise funds and find a cure for such a deadly disease. He does this every year and it is fun to come out here and play some golf, meet new people, and just have some fun. So we are just here to support Will at the end of the day. This is all for Will.

quotes.speaker: Keyonte George
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George on Utah Jazz team chemistry and expectations
quotes.excerpt: The main thing is to expect to see a real collective group that loves each other.
quotes.quote: The main thing is to expect to see a real collective group that loves each other, that will fight for each other. That is what you want in the NBA with a team. We have been fighting for the camaraderie piece this whole summer. We are going to compete every single night. The last couple of seasons, they haven't went how we wanted them to go, so now we get another chance to really fight and see what we are about as a group.

quotes.speaker: Keyonte George
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George's personal development goals for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: I just want to continue to grow, mentally, physically, grow as a leader.
quotes.quote: I just want to continue to grow, mentally, physically, grow as a leader. Obviously, there are some individual goals that we all have as players, but for me, I am really focused on us as a group. Our motto is show love. When you talk about showing love, it is outside yourself. So this whole season, I am really worried about how can we compete at the highest level for 82 games.

quotes.speaker: Keyonte George
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George on the security of his new contract extension
quotes.excerpt: As a player, you get the security, being able to stay with a team for your whole career.
quotes.quote: As a player, you get the security, being able to stay with a team for your whole career. You don't see that for a lot of players, so I feel like this is just the start of something. Extended with the team, showing Lowry, Deron, our top guys that you know I am here to stay. I want to find a way to win in Utah.

quotes.speaker: Mark Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George on his relationship with Darryn Peterson
quotes.excerpt: You made a beeline to Darryn Peterson. Take me through that.

text_blocks.speaker: Mark Spears
text_blocks.text: I spoke at this event two years ago. My dad died of ALS and Coach Hardy is doing great things for the ALS community. But hey, at the draft lottery, man, after you guys got the number two pick, there is a lot of talent in the room, but you made a beeline to Darryn Peterson. Take me through that and what did you guys talk about? Why did you make a beeline to him?

text_blocks.speaker: Keyonte George
text_blocks.text: We got a top two pick and in that draft, we can do the top two players. Obviously, we kind of had a relationship a little bit before that. I don't know, man, I think it was just the guard connection. I don't know. I just told him congratulations to him in advance. I have already heard about his work ethic, what type of person he is. So yeah, it was just a little small talk, put my little gems in there here and there, but I am just glad he is on the team now.

quotes.speaker: Keyonte George
quotes.summary_phrase: Keyonte George on what impresses him about Darryn Peterson's game
quotes.excerpt: I think just how fast he picks up on things. Obviously, in this league, it is split second.
quotes.quote: I think just how fast he picks up on things. Obviously, in this league, it is split second. You can make that mistake and it is over. I think for him, we talk about different things whether it is picking roll, or iso spacing, or even little things with our jump shots. He picks up on it right away and he is always willing to learn. So I think that is the main thing, coming in as a high pick and still humble enough to still want to learn.
